metadata.note: Derived expansion corridor massing on the government-derived land boundary, not survey-grade reconstruction. Original WGS84 footprints and relative roof heights; flat ground; connected-part minimum base datum and upper-envelope podium/tower silhouettes. Buildings clipped to the land boundary and 3.5m beyond the surface carriageways. Missing heights use storeys x 3.2m or 9.6m. Facades, paving and vegetation are authored; selected street centrelines come from the Transport Department; the western coastline comes from LandsD iB1000 Shoreline and CartoHydroLine seawall/high-water features, with recorded short gap repairs; prior building regions are excluded to avoid duplicate geometry. Base datums are reconciled across all seven Kowloon extracts before regional clipping; duplicate BuildingCSUID records share one group. TopHeight and fallback Storeys use the newest retrieved_utc record per BuildingCSUID (original undated extract: 2026-09-13 UTC; ties prefer west coast, Tsuen Wan, Kwai Chung, northwest, west, north, original). Each region retains its own source footprint and OBJECTID.
